selection_rule: Within each stratum/scramble/component, retain the first Nk rows in the source order; preserve source order when combining selected indices
weight_rule: Recompute logimportance+logalpha_k-logNk-logR+logrho_s; never reuse source normalized weights
uncertainty_rule: Use frozen scramble integral covariance and ratio delta method, never iid-row MCSE
summary_scope: 11 physical parameters, 4 existing derived TF quantities, and 3 fixed branches
evaluation_guard: Require completed.json and an exited config.pid before opening any scientific raw results
execution_authorization: Do not evaluate until root explicitly notifies completion; implementation and non-GP self-test only before then
limitations: The three estimates reuse nested prefixes of the same eight scramble streams and are correlated
Eight scramble integrals supply only seven covariance degrees of freedom
Posterior ratio estimates and delta-method MCSE are approximate; unseen rare contributions remain possible
No independent-seed convergence claim, full 4x3 completion, physical component identity, distance or H0 claim
